longDescription: People Development Planning. Planning Functionalities. Resourcing and Succession Planning. Planning of Milestones. Business Case Studies. Costs and Benefits of Planning. Smart target settings. Professional Certificate in People Development and Human Resource Management explores key concepts to prepare the learner for the challenge of developing people within an organisation. The aim is to equip the learner with tools and strategies used in effective human resource management to plan and execute development programmes throughout the organisation.
